evidence_retention: Existing private backend tmpfs only, approved latest 50 bundles / maximum 24 hours. No restart, new raw export, retention extension or deletion this round. This report stores summaries/metadata/digests and short excerpts, not full raw outputs or credentials.
limitations: Fixed repeated configurations, not a representative random sample; do not infer long-run reliability from 30 attempts.
This tests unchanged r6, not a new optimization; no causality claim about prompt vs other provider behavior.
Reported usage lacks reasoning/cache-hit and monetary billing breakdown.
No independent QA/UAT, full-site regression, permanent library save or review-session test.
